# Anne & Rachel Lynde

- [Anne](../character/anne.md) — Friend of — [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) — well-meaning older neighbour and advisor · since v2  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P54](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0054)</sub>
- _previously:_ [Anne](../character/anne.md) — Enemy of — [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) (until v1)  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and insults Anne's appearance, prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to fly into a furious rage and insult Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) in return. After Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) leaves in huff, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) confronts [Anne](../character/anne.md) in her bedroom and demands she apologize, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) fiercely refuses.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified

> After [Anne](../character/anne.md) refuses to leave her room or eat, [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) secretly visits her and gently convinces her to apologize to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) to smooth things over. [Anne](../character/anne.md) dramatic apologizes to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who forgives her completely and offers her hope about her hair color. Walking back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels an unaccustomed warmth toward [Anne](../character/anne.md) as the young girl expresses her happiness at finally having a home.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER X. Anne’s Apology

> After being punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) and forced to sit next to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md) decides to leave school permanently. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) seeks advice from Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), who suggests letting [Anne](../character/anne.md) stay home until she cools down. Later, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) finds [Anne](../character/anne.md) weeping over imaginary future sorrow about [Diana](../character/diana.md) getting married, which sends [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) into a rare fit of laughter.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

> While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) attend a political rally in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) spend a quiet evening together studying and talking. [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) rushes in to beg for help because her sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) is gravely ill with croup while their parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne.md) hurries to the [Barry](../character/barry.md) home and successfully treats [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) using her past experience with Mrs. Hammond's children, saving the baby's life. Touched by Anne's rescue, Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) forgives her for the past incident with [Diana](../character/diana.md), allowing the two girls to be best friends once again.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends a restful summer outdoors per doctor's orders before resuming her studies for the upcoming [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations. As the school year progresses, [Anne](../character/anne.md) matures into a quieter fifteen-year-old girl, growing taller than [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and shifting her focus to simple, disciplined writing. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) feels a sense of loss over [Anne](../character/anne.md) growing up, while [Anne](../character/anne.md) worries about the anxiety and potential failure surrounding the crucial exams.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

> While [Anne](../character/anne.md) daydreams on the doorstep, Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) angrily confronts her about her cow getting into his oats. [Anne](../character/anne.md) retorts about his baldness before securing the cow, and later discusses the incident over tea with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md). Mrs. Rachel shares local news, including upcoming changes in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and new students expected in Anne's classroom.
>
> — v2 · I An Irate Neighbor

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) begins her first day teaching school, forgetting her prepared speech but managing her new pupils, including the sullen [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) and a bright, imaginative boy named [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). After school, an excessively dressed Mrs. Donnell visits to demand specific pronunciations and names for her children. On her walk home, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) gives [Anne](../character/anne.md) wild orchids, brightening her mood before she returns to recount her day to [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v2 · V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), whose playful and rowdy behavior immediately poses a challenge for [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md). At church on Sunday, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) creates a commotion by dropping a caterpillar down [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md) White's neck during the service. Later in the week, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) ruins Dora's dress by forcing her to walk the pigpen fence and pumps water over her, subsequently confessing to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he also hid a toad in Marilla's bed.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) converses with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) on his porch about [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), Davy's antics, and the Village Improvement Society's hall painting project. Later, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) discovers that [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) has accidentally painted the hall a bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up in color codes. [The Improvers](../codex/factions.md#improvers) gather at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in despair over the blunder, but the town's sympathy ultimately turns in their favor against the [Pyes](../codex/factions.md#pyes).
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

> Suffering from a severe toothache, [Anne](../character/anne.md) has a disastrous and irritable day at school, accidentally throwing a package of fireworks into the stove and later whipping [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. She returns home distraught over losing her temper, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts her. The next day, to Anne's surprise, Anthony shows newfound respect for her, which Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) later confirms was earned through the whipping.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

> After the guests depart, [Anne](../character/anne.md) learns via a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle and cannot visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) sit together in the evening discussing the day's mishaps, how to replace Miss Barry's broken platter, and neighborhood gossip about Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). As they finish talking, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) walks up the lane.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

> During breakfast, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) discuss Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and the situation with [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), all while managing Davy's lively table manners. [Anne](../character/anne.md) promises to help [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) make an [Indian](../codex/factions.md#indian) headdress using old feathers. Later, news arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died, leaving a trust fund that ensures the twins can remain permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v2 · XXII Odds and Ends

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne.md) how he and his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), originally separated over housecleaning habits and his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), leading to their eventual reconciliation. [Emily](../character/emily.md) returns and warmly welcomes [Anne](../character/anne.md), after which [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) are present.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's passing, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) come to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so that [Anne](../character/anne.md) can attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne.md) accepts the opportunity with mixed emotions and resigns her teaching post, prompting reactions from her pupils and [Diana](../character/diana.md).
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

> Rebelling against Mrs. Lynde's instructions, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) convinces [Dora](../character/dora.md) to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) so they can go fishing and play with the [Cottons](../codex/factions.md#cottons). Afterwards, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) lies to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) to cover up his disobedience, but he is tormented by his guilty conscience. Late that night, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses everything to [Anne](../character/anne.md), who forgives him and encourages him to apologize to [God](../character/god.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIII The Way of Transgressors

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends an evening in the garden with [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully confesses her fear of dying and her desire to go on living. Shortly after [Anne](../character/anne.md) leaves, [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md) passes away peacefully in her sleep. Following the funeral, [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects on life and death while walking home with [Diana](../character/diana.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md).
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIV The Summons

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for a snowbound and lonely [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) vacation, feeling embarrassed by Gilbert's romantic attentions and worried about her finances for her next year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). While conversing with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and receiving letters brought by Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), she worries about dropping out of college to teach. However, a letter arrives revealing that Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md) has died and left [Anne](../character/anne.md) a thousand dollars in her will, securing her financial future.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) joins [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) outside on a June evening. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) complains about his schoolwork and the local funerals, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) offers to help him with his arithmetic. The conversation turns to local gossip, including Diana's upcoming wedding to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) and the town's reaction to [Anne](../character/anne.md) rejecting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) later wanders down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), feeling melancholic about Gilbert's absence and the changes that growing up brings.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVIII A June Evening

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana.md) prepare for her wedding at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), reflecting on their lifelong friendship as [Diana](../character/diana.md) nervously prepares to walk down the aisle. After the ceremony, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) escorts [Anne](../character/anne.md) home and they take a moonlight walk through Lovers' Lane. During their walk, [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses her plans to substitute as a teacher in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) and feels a bittersweet nostalgia for how much [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) has changed.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) feeling a sense of disappointment and loneliness following her rejection of [Roy Gardner](../character/roy-gardner.md). She learns local gossip from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), hears news of friends' engagements and marriages, visits Diana's new baby, and attends Phil's wedding.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and learns from her family that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. Keeping a stormy night watch in her room, [Anne](../character/anne.md) realizes she has always loved [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and despairs over her foolishness. In the morning, she meets [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) Buote in the yard and learns that Gilbert's fever has broken and he will recover.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XL A Book of Revelation

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) excitedly prepare wedding gifts and discuss Anne's upcoming marriage. Later, [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), Mrs. [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), and Mrs. Jasper Bell visit to view Anne's trousseau and offer mixed comments. Finally, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives and joins [Anne](../character/anne.md) for a walk, describing the seaside house in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) he has found for their new home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses her upcoming wedding plans and guest list with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md). Friends and family arrive at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the ceremony, including [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), as well as [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) and her husband. On the evening before her wedding, [Anne](../character/anne.md) visits Matthew's grave and walks home with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), reflecting happily on their shared past and upcoming future.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) awakens on her wedding day at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and reflects on her past in her little room. Friends and family gather as preparations finish and [Anne](../character/anne.md) marries [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the sunshine of the old orchard. After a joyous celebration, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) depart for [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary as their loved ones bid them farewell.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) goes for a evening walk on the shore of [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor) and encounters [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), her mysterious neighbor. They share a conversation about their surroundings, beauty, and pasts before agreeing to exchange visits. Returning home, [Anne](../character/anne.md) discusses her encounter and impressions of [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) host their first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at their home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) visiting from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Captain Jim and Miss Cornelia join as dinner guests, engaging in lively debate and storytelling over the holiday meal.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS

> During a cold winter, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) spend time together, though [Anne](../character/anne.md) senses a lingering distance and occasional resentment from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). Captain Jim explains to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that Leslie's past tragedy creates a barrier between them. After [Anne](../character/anne.md) hints at her pregnancy, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) reacts coldly but later gifts her a handmade baby dress. Meanwhile, Captain Jim shares his journal of sea adventures with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), who hope someone will one day write his life story.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER

> [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) agrees to write Captain Jim's life story combined with the tale of lost [Margaret](../character/margaret.md), and he sets up a workspace at the lighthouse. Over a memorable summer, Owen works intensely on the manuscript while spending joyful leisure time with [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), and Captain Jim. As September arrives, Owen finishes the main draft of his book and announces that his stay at [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor) is coming to an end.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK

> Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) to read obituaries and gossip about local history and Owen Ford's effect on [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). After [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) enters, the conversation shifts to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) mourning her old dog [Carlo](../character/carlo.md), before [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) spend the holidays in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) and return to [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), where Captain Jim shares news that his life-book will be published.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS
